sn35.105:1.1: kisminnu kho bhikkhave sati kiṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
sn35.105:2.1: bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā, bhagavannettikā bhagavampaṭisaraṇā, sādhu vata bhante, bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho, bhagavato sutvā bhikkhu dhāressantīti. tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmīti. evambhanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn35.105:3.1: cakkhusmiṃ kho bhikkhave sati cakkhuṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ, sotasmiṃ sati sotaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ, ghānasmiṃ sati ghānaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ, jivhāya sati jivhaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ,
sn35.105:3.2: manasmiṃ sati manaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ.
sn35.105:7.1: “yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ apinu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti”.
sn35.105:8.1: no hetaṃ bhante. “sotaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti. aniccaṃ bhante. …pe… “ghānaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti. aniccaṃ bhante. …pe…
sn35.105:19.1: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ apinu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
sn35.105:21.1: evampassaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, sotasmimpi nibbindati, ghānasmimpi nibbindati. jivhāyapi nibbindati. kāyasmimpi nibbindati, manasmimpi nibbindati,
sn35.105:21.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.105:21.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
